    .fillet(inner_corner_radius) # Apply fillet to round the corners
)

# Combine the profiles and extrude
# The .cut() operation here is on 2D profiles, which is equivalent to creating a wire with a hole.
# This is preferred over 3D boolean operations.
result = (
    outer_profile
    .cut(inner_profile)
    .extrude(extrusion_height)
)
